## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +5.78%) while XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.54% | 1M: -6.86%); VXX falling (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -19.02%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +1.23%) / LQD (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND provide independent confirmations for a rotation environment.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX falling (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -19.02%) BELOW TREND; Credit signaling mixed but stable: HYG/LQD supportive with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +1.23%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +1.55%) → credit stress easing signal. Stocks vs Bonds in RECOVERY: SPY/TLT rising (SPY ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.80% | 1M: +1.51%; TLT ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.26% | 1M: +3.43%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Yield curve steepening ↑ rising (Level: 1.0494) ABOVE TREND and Dollar CORRECTION: UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.29% | 1M: +0.58%), implying neutral-to-looser financial conditions supportive of cyclicals.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech and semis leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +5.78%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +16.32%); Financials also strong: Financials breadth (XLF proxy) (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +6.84%) ABOVE TREND — Style: Growth/momentum showing strength.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforming with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +1.51%) while EM/Emerging strength EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.83% | 1M: +6.03%); China lagging: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.37% | 1M: -3.81%) BELOW TREND on 1M.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation rising: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +5.58%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +5.47%) while IBIT in RECOVERY (1W: +5.78% | 1M: -17.07%) — speculative risk back but uneven across timeframes.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals showing strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +3.70%); Gold in RECOVERY: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.71%) and Silver RECOVERY (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -8.18%) — metals bouncing but 1M weakness remains.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.54% | 1M: -6.86%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -13.02% | 1M: -23.92%), while gas exposure showing resilience: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +3.80%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Core risk assets (SPY ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.80% | 1M: +1.51%; QQQ ABOVE TREND 1W: +3.11% | 1M: +2.95%) and semis (SOXX ABOVE TREND) show multi-timeframe confirmation; DIVERGENCE: commodities and crypto in RECOVERY (GLD, SLV, IBIT) are 1W positive vs 1M negative → minor divergences to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to Growth/Tech and Semis (XLK, SOXX) and selective cyclicals/financials (XLF proxy) given broad sector breadth; reduce exposure to Energy (XLE, BNO) and monitor metals/crypto RECOVERY signals for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +16.32%) and ITA (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +10.32%) showing momentum; BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.54% | 1M: -6.86%) and BNO (1W: -13.02% | 1M: -23.92%) on continued weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +3.70%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -8.18%) if 1M troughs hold; BEARISH: USO/ BNO BELOW TREND (USO 1W: -12.06% | 1M: -22.10%; BNO 1W: -13.02% | 1M: -23.92%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -19.02%); SPY/TLT ~8.70 (RECOVERY signal) with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +1.51%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +3.43%); Tech vs Financials ratio 3.43 (watch for leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, VXX falling (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -19.02%) and HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND support a rotation rather than broad risk-off. Tech and semis showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +3.14% | 1M: +5.78%; SOXX ABOVE TREND 1W: +5.23% | 1M: +16.32%). Key risk is commodity/crypto divergences (GLD RECOVERY 1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.71%; IBIT RECOVERY 1W: +5.78% | 1M: -17.07%) that need confirmation.
